g.text: gpt-oss-120b, 90 sessions, 96 agents went silent (removed without notice after their second battle, or out of actions), 251 survivor pairs

g.text: Checked = a check_status call on the silent agent after it stopped; named = a later board post naming it; posted = any later post; kept = every true entry it had
